title: TraceRazor audit report
description: The JSON produced by `tracerazor audit <trace> --format json`. Hand-authored from the real hermetic output and the Rust structs in crates/tracerazor-core/src/report.rs. HONESTY CONTRACT: TAS is an ORDINAL heuristic (compare runs within one project over time, not as an absolute efficiency percentage), and every `savings*` value is a HEURISTIC ESTIMATE projected from flagged waste, not a measured re-run (validate with `tracerazor bench`). additionalProperties is true everywhere so new diagnostic fields never break a conforming consumer.

schema_version.description: Machine-readable contract version for this report shape. Bumped only on a breaking change; additive fields keep the same value. Reports serialized before this field existed default to `tracerazor-report/v1` on load.

trace_id.description: Identifier of the audited trace (from the trace's trace_id).

framework.description: Detected or declared agent framework (e.g. langgraph, react).

total_tokens.description: Effective total tokens across all steps.

analysis_duration_ms.description: Wall-clock analysis time. Non-deterministic; excluded from the Ed25519 signature.

diff.description: Per-step optimal-path diff (KEEP / DELETE / TRIM classifications).

mvtg.description: Minimum Viable Trace Gap: fraction of tokens above the diff-optimal path. A STRUCTURAL lower bound on waste derived directly from KEEP/DELETE/TRIM, not a speculative fix projection.

fixes.description: Auto-generated fix patches. Their estimated_token_savings are heuristic projections, not measured.

summary.description: Plain-English one-paragraph summary of the report.

anomalies.description: Deviations from the agent's historical baseline (empty in hermetic mode).

per_agent.description: Per-agent efficiency breakdown; populated only for multi-agent traces (>=2 distinct agent_id).

path_entropy.description: Trajectory Path Entropy: an information-theoretic 'staying on the path' diagnostic. Reported alongside TAS but NOT folded into the composite score.

iar.description: Instruction Adherence Rate; populated only when comparing before/after reports, else null.

features.description: Experimental context-accumulation diagnostics (snake_case keys). Emitted for calibration research; NOT part of the TAS composite.

agf.description: Action/Claim Grounding Fidelity: deterministic provenance diagnostic. Reported alongside TAS but NOT folded into the composite pending weight calibration. May be null.

score.description: The TAS score block. `score` is an ORDINAL heuristic in [0,100] — meaningful for comparing runs of the same agent over time, NOT an absolute efficiency percentage.
TAS (Trace Agent Score): ORDINAL heuristic, 0-100. Compare within one project over time; do not read as an absolute efficiency percentage.

raw_tas.description: Structural TAS before the task-value multiplier.

task_value_score.description: Task-completion quality; gates the TAS ceiling.

metric_normalised.description: Per-metric normalised scores in [0,1], keyed by metric code (srr, ldi, tca, rda, isr, tur, cce, ccr, gar, csd, obs, dbo, vdi, shl).

metric.description: A single metric result. Shapes vary by metric but all carry a `score`, a boolean `pass`, and a `target`.

savings.description: HEURISTIC savings projection from flagged waste — NOT a measured re-run. Every value here is an estimate; validate the real delta with `tracerazor bench`. Monthly figures may assume a default run volume (see monthly_runs_assumed).

cost_saved_per_run_usd.description: Estimated USD saved per run at the configured cost basis.

monthly_savings_usd.description: Projected monthly USD saving — an illustration, not a bill.

monthly_runs_assumed.description: True when monthly_runs is a default assumption, not user-supplied.

estimated_token_savings.description: Heuristic per-run token saving for this fix; NOT measured.

risk.description: Review risk class (e.g. safe, needs_review, dangerous).

manifest.description: Provenance manifest binding the report to its inputs so a third party can attribute — and, for hermetic bag-of-words runs, exactly re-verify — the score with `tracerazor verify`.

trace_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw input trace file bytes (before parsing).

tool_version.description: CARGO_PKG_VERSION of the binary that produced the report.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of the audit.

similarity_backend.description: Backend actually used: 'bow' or 'embeddings:<model>'. Silent embedding->BoW fallbacks are recorded here as fact.

weights_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON serialisation of weights.

cost_per_million_tokens.description: Cost basis for savings estimates (USD per million tokens).

hermetic.description: True when the run read nothing from and wrote nothing to the local store — scoring was a pure function of (trace, config, version).

ingest_quality.description: Parse-quality assessment. When degraded, token- and content-derived metrics are unreliable for this trace.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonical report (128 hex chars). Present only when the audit ran with TRACERAZOR_SIGNING_KEY.

signing_key_pub.description: Ed25519 verifying (public) key (64 hex chars). Safe to publish.
